metadata.title: Conformal structures and rigidity of complete stable minimal hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We study complete stable minimal hypersurfaces in Riemannian manifolds under various curvature assumptions. In an $(n+1)$-dimensional complete oriented manifold with nonnegative scalar curvature, we prove that no complete oriented noncompact stable minimal hypersurface can be conformally equivalent to a bounded domain in an $n$-dimensional manifold with nonpositive scalar curvature. As a consequence, there exists no complete stable minimal hypersurface in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ that is conformally equivalent to a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$. We also show that compact stable minimal hypersurfaces in manifolds with nonnegative scalar curvature have nonnegative smooth Yamabe invariant and we characterize the equality case. Next, we consider complete two-sided stable minimal hypersurfaces in ambient manifolds with pinched sectional curvature. Under an additional curvature condition that makes the second fundamental form a Codazzi tensor, we obtain a rigidity result under an $L^2$-condition on the second fundamental form and derive an upper bound for the first eigenvalue of the Laplacian. Finally, we establish that any complete noncompact two-sided minimal hypersurface immersed in a warped product manifold is stable, provided that the angle function is positive and the second derivative of the warping function is nonnegative.

analysis.workSummary: 研究稳定极小超曲面的共形类型、Yamabe 不变量及带额外 Codazzi 条件的 L² 刚性，并给出翘曲积中由角函数控制的稳定性条件。
analysis.breakthrough: 将稳定极小超曲面的共形禁阻、谱界和特殊环境中的刚性放在共同框架中。
analysis.limitations: 各定理的可定向/双侧、环境曲率、Codazzi 和 L² 假设不同，不能相互省略。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 稳定性与标量曲率关系接近本组几何分析兴趣，值得核对各条假设。
